description:
CRUX, ATOMIC. Switch construction, transport lane reprs, and codegen dispatch on the CallConvention fact together -- they must agree at all times, so this is one inch.

WHAT/HOW:
1. Transport: callable boundary published lane reprs AND the executable ReturnDelivery repr derive from the convention (Typed -> raw arg/return lanes; Boxed -> ValueRef). RIP OUT the boxed_first_class blanket in derive_codegen_seam_facts and the coarse boundary_escapes_into_fz_space gate. For a Typed callable, boundary and body reprs now AGREE by construction (the codegen body==boundary return check passes because both are the convention's reprs -- this is the fault-4 resolution, done right at the source instead of by flowing a boxed-return obligation).
2. Codegen construction: a Typed callable's closure code pointer is its BODY entry (fn_ids[body_sid] -- already computed and discarded as _body_sid in collect_static_closure_targets), not the boxed wrapper. Captures still live in self; the body projects them (unchanged ABI (typed_args, self, cont)).
3. Codegen dispatch: emit_call_closure indirect path splits on convention -- Typed builds a typed signature (raw args, self, cont)->raw ret and call_indirects the body entry; Boxed keeps the current all-ValueRef path. The single-lit direct fast path stays (it is the Typed convention with a known identity, optimized to a by-name call).

WHY: a typed convention can be dispatched by a typed call_indirect through the code pointer; captures ride in self (verified: push_direct_closure_args passes no explicit captures; both direct and wrapper call the body the same way). No box of args or return; add_a returns a raw int straight to the monomorphized reduce loop.

NO SHIMS: the boxed wrapper is NOT generated for Typed callables; nothing adapts -- the body is called at its native ABI.

CHECK: opaque_fn_value_join + 00231 compile (build) AND run with correct output; the reducer does not heap-allocate per step (assert via Process.heap_alloc_stats, which the fixture already samples -- the no-alloc oracle); a telemetry assertion that reducer.() dispatches typed-indirect and add_a return repr == RawInt == boundary repr. Full lib + matrix green, zero warnings, no regressions (esp. resource destructor / provider-callback / escaped-lambda boundary tests, which are direct/grounded/genuinely-boxed and must not flip).
title: Honor the calling convention: typed construction, lane reprs, and dispatch (atomic)
